## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach in one or two short paragraphs.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Breaking change

## Related issue

Closes #

## Verification

List the commands, devices, and scenarios used to verify the change.

```text
npm test
npm run build
```

## UI evidence

For visible changes, add before/after screenshots or a short recording. State
the platform and device/simulator used.

## Public API and documentation

- [ ] Public types, hooks, props, or runtime behavior are documented.
- [ ] Examples were updated when setup or usage changed.
- [ ] Migration notes are included for a breaking change.

## Risk and rollback

Describe important tradeoffs, data or runtime compatibility concerns, and how
the change can be rolled back if necessary.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one problem.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Relevant lint checks pass.
- [ ] Accessibility was considered for UI changes.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, or private URLs are included.
